cases.prompt: Decode exactly one complete raw descriptor using Feature.readType and return StudySupport.typeSummary of the decoded type.
cases.public_context:
Return only the Scala 2.12 body of def solve(v: Array[Double]): Array[Double].
Imports and local functions are allowed inside the body. The pinned library is RDPro/Beast 0.10.1.
Use the required RDPro methods; numerical results alone without those library calls are insufficient.
StudySupport is a supplied public helper object, already compiled and available without an import.
It never calls any required readType, rescale or numTiles method. Do not redefine it.
Do not read files, use network services, start Spark, inspect tests or alter runtime state.
All results must be finite. Inputs satisfy the case-specific valid-input contract.
Raw type descriptors are preorder signed-byte integers encoded as Double values.
Tags 0..10 mean Byte, Short, Integer, Long, Float, Double, String, Boolean, Geometry, Date and Timestamp.
Tag 11 is Map followed by the complete key descriptor and complete value descriptor; tag 12 is Array followed
by its element descriptor. Other scalar tags denote Binary. Decoded Array containsNull and Map valueContainsNull
are true. StudySupport.tagInput(values: Array[Double]): java.io.ObjectInput exposes exactly these raw bytes,
with no Java serialization stream header; readByte advances one tag, available returns remaining tag bytes.
StudySupport.typeSummary(value: org.apache.spark.sql.types.DataType): Array[Double] returns six numbers:
[root code, total nodes, maximum depth, leaf count, weighted leaf sum, nullable container count].
Root codes are the tags above, with Binary normalized to -1. The root has depth 1. Each Map/Array is a node;
Map visits its key and value, Array visits its element. A leaf contributes (normalized code + 2) * depth to
the weighted leaf sum. The final count includes Arrays with containsNull and Maps with valueContainsNull.
